zin_regional_dondor_join_war = {
	Y19 = {
		every_enemy_country = {
			ROOT = { add_to_war = { targeted_alliance = Y19 enemy = PREV hostility_reason = asked_to_join single_target_only = yes } }
		}
	}
}

zin_regional_dondor_iron_trade = {
	every_neighbor_country = {
		limit = { zin_dark_is_free_hold = yes }
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = zin_regional_dondor_iron_trade }
	}
}

zin_regional_dondor_invite_holds = {
	random_other_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_dark_is_free_hold = yes
			is_in_faction = no
			check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway < 40 }
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_regional_dondor_invited
		country_event = { id = zin_dark.20 }
	}
	random_other_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_dark_is_free_hold = yes
			is_in_faction = no
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_regional_dondor_invited }
		}
		country_event = { id = zin_dark.20 }
	}
	every_other_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_regional_dondor_invited }
		clear_country_flag = zin_regional_dondor_invited
	}
}

zin_regional_dondor_greet_moot = {
	every_other_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member }
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = zin_regional_dondor_same_shore }
		ROOT = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_regional_dondor_same_shore } }
	}
}

zin_regional_dondor_claim_march = {
	every_state = {
		limit = { zin_is_site_goldoroth_march = yes }
		add_claim_by = ROOT
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_who (country), zin_arg_modifier (1-based position in the opinion_modifiers block), zin_arg_both (1 for both ways).
zin_regional_dondor_opinion = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 1 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_regional_dondor_beacon_kin
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_regional_dondor_beacon_kin
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {

		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_regional_dondor_iron_trade
			}
		}

			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 3 }
		}

			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_regional_dondor_same_shore

			limit = {

			}

				target = var:zin_arg_who
